title: Prenuvo testimonial
description: A photo-backed night section with an arced top that tucks over the section before it. On the left, a big semibold claim, a pair of seafoam quote marks, a quote set in bold italic, a name with a quiet role, and a green-to-blue pill; the photo fills the rest behind a scrim from the left. The copy rises 96px and fades in as it arrives.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); about one window tall on desktop (min 100svh), content-sized on phones
media fills the section like object-fit: cover (a portrait photo or video); empty shows a placeholder
